$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the New Tab page's widgets; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: newTabWidgets
lists.note: The Minimal New Tab layout's widgets (Leo 2026-10-20: "only do the composer for the default"): Minimal, the default tabs.newTabTemplate, is a greeting and the composer, with the quick action pills under it and the template dots under the page (Leo 2026-10-22, about the pills and the dots: "let's turn it back on"); the project card and the recent chats are widgets, off by default. The other layouts draw what they always drew. The app sends the ones on as the page's pageWidgets (webviews newtab/pageWidgets.ts).

rows.note: On by default: a short greeting by the time of day over the composer.

help.text: A short greeting over the composer.

rows.note: Off by default. On: Default's card of this Mac and its recent projects, with the page in Default's stage. The composer's project strip picks a folder either way.

help.text: A card of this Mac and its recent projects over the composer.

rows.note: On by default (Leo 2026-10-22: "let's turn it back on"). On Minimal alone: New Terminal, New Browser Tab and New Chat as pills under the composer; with the project card or the recent chats on, the stage's card of the chats that need you and the same three. The palette and the pane's + menu have them either way.

title.text: Show Quick Actions on New Tab

help.text: Chats that need you, and New Terminal, New Browser Tab and New Chat.

rows.note: Off by default. On: the recent chats as rows under the composer. The palette (Cmd-P) finds a chat either way.

title.text: Show Recent Chats on New Tab

help.text: Your recent chats under the composer. The palette finds any chat.

rows.name: styleDots
rows.note: On by default (Leo 2026-10-22: "let's turn it back on"): the dots under the page that switch its template (tabs.newTabTemplate), after the composer's two look dots.

title.text: Show Template Dots on New Tab

help.text: Dots under the page that switch its template.
